items: Guest surveys let you hear and fix complaints privately before they become public reviews, while growing your customer database and showing performance by location, shift and channel.
Keep the survey short and relevant: route dine-in and delivery guests separately, ask for an overall rating and category ratings, and add an NPS question.
Show follow-up questions, comments and photo uploads only when a category scores low, and close with a thank-you reward so guests have a reason to finish and return.
After responses come in, segment them, fix the top recurring complaints first, share findings with your teams, follow up with unhappy guests and track scores month over month.
Momos runs customizable surveys by SMS or email, prompts happy guests to post Google reviews and sends negative feedback into an automated customer recovery workflow.
